Our Services

End-to-End Safety Support

From audits and site surveys to custom fabrication and installation, we provide complete safety services that help you protect people and stay compliant.

Safety Audit

Evaluate your workplace hazards, equipment, and processes to identify risks and recommend compliant control measures.

  • Risk assessment & gap analysis
  • Compliance checklists
  • Actionable safety reports

Signage Consultation

Get expert guidance on selecting the right safety signs, labels, and markings for your facility and operations.

  • ISO 7010 compliant designs
  • Site-specific placements
  • Material & size recommendations

Site Survey

Our team visits your location to measure, map, and plan signage layouts that maximize visibility and coverage.

  • On-site measurements
  • Traffic & pedestrian flow analysis
  • Installation planning

Custom Fabrication

Manufacture safety signs, barricades, and equipment in custom sizes, materials, and languages for your needs.

  • Retro-reflective & glow options
  • Custom legends & logos
  • Bulk production

Installation Support

End-to-end support for installing signs, road safety products, and industrial safety equipment correctly.

  • Proper mounting heights
  • Visibility checks
  • Maintenance advice

After-Sales Service

Stay supported long after purchase with replacements, reorders, and ongoing compliance consultations.

  • Replacement warranties
  • Reordering assistance
  • Compliance updates
Compliance

Safety Solutions That Meet National Standards

We design, manufacture, and recommend safety products in line with Indian and international regulations — so your workplace stays compliant, audit-ready, and safe.

Request Compliance Checklist

ISO 7010 Safety Signs

All our safety signs follow ISO 7010 standards for shape, color, and symbols to ensure universal recognition.

Indian Road Safety Norms

Road signs, barricades, cones, and tapes are manufactured in line with IRC and MORTH guidelines for traffic safety.

Factories Act Compliance

We help factories meet signage, emergency exit, and safety equipment requirements under the Factories Act, 1948.

Fire & Emergency Standards

Fire safety signs and emergency evacuation plans align with NBC and local fire authority requirements.
